problem: Ledger balance treats debits as deposits.
requirement: A credit of 100 and a debit of 40 MUST equal 60.
approach: Write unittest methods that use bare assert, watch them fail, sign the debits, and rerun the same module.
task: Land the claimed behavior and record the verification command.
title: Fix a ledger bug with bare asserts in unittest
description: balance() summed every amount and ignored kind. tests/test_ledger.py is a unittest.TestCase whose checks are bare assert statements: credit 100 plus debit 40 equals 60, and a debit of 15 equals -15. python3 -m unittest tests.test_ledger fails, then the sign is applied and the same command passes.
rubricNote: Bugfix with real assertions that failed on the unsigned sum and passed after debits were subtracted. The assertions are pytest-style bare asserts inside a unittest file.
claim: balance() added every amount and ignored debits. tests/test_ledger.py uses bare assert, not self.assertEqual: credit 100 and debit 40 must equal 60, and a debit of 15 must equal -15. python3 -m unittest tests.test_ledger failed. I signed debits and reran the same command. It passed.
